name: "Fairness" Trap Inoculation
stage: De-escalation, Resistance Defusal & Countering Bad Faith
scenario: Procurement agent says: "We have provided all the documentation you asked for; we just expect you to be fair with your pricing."
script: "Fairness is core to our business philosophy. Please hold me accountable: stop me immediately if you feel I have treated you unfairly, and let us examine the objective market data together."
defense: Answer fairness with evidence: it is measured by comparable transactions and shared margin risk; review the rate cards.
originFull: Moral Saliency and Guilt Induction demonstrate that manipulators weaponize the word "fair" to induce guilt and force unearned concessions.
defenseFull: Disarming fairness accusations: "Fairness is not an abstract emotional sentiment; it is measured by comparable market transactions and shared margin risk. Let us review the audited rate cards for comparable implementations."
